summary: The diff implements a React/TanStack Router SPA instead of the explicitly required static HTML5/CSS/JS (plain HTML files: index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html). While most content requirements (header, footer, pages, HubSpot placeholder, .env, README) appear to be addressed functionally, the technology stack fundamentally violates the constraints. Several specific structural and delivery requirements are also missing or unverifiable.

missing_requirements.requirement: Package all files as a downloadable ZIP archive and provide it as the final output.
missing_requirements.reason: No ZIP file is created or referenced anywhere in the diff. The output is a React project, not a packaged ZIP archive.

missing_requirements.requirement: All image assets must be in a dedicated /images folder; all img tags must reference paths under /images/.
missing_requirements.reason: The Services page references images under '/assets/generated/' (e.g., service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png), not '/images/'. No /images folder is created in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Static HTML5/CSS/JS only — no React or any JavaScript framework (plain HTML5/CSS/JS only).
missing_requirements.reason: The entire implementation uses React with TanStack Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS — directly violating the constraint 'No React or any JavaScript framework — plain HTML5/CSS/JS only' and the requirement for static HTML files (index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html).

missing_requirements.requirement: Output must be static HTML5 files (index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html).
missing_requirements.reason: No static .html files are produced. The project is a React SPA compiled from TSX sources, not static HTML5 pages.

hallucinated_features.description: React + TanStack Router + TypeScript SPA architecture
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly prohibits React or any JavaScript framework and requires plain HTML5/CSS/JS only. The implementation uses React, TanStack Router, TypeScript, and JSX/TSX throughout.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity / ICP authentication integration (useInternetIdentity, useActor, AuthClient, backend/main.mo)
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request is for a simple static corporate website with no authentication, blockchain, or ICP/Internet Computer backend. These files are entirely unrelated to any stated requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media icon links (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook) in the footer
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention social media links anywhere in the footer or site requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: FAQ section on the Contact Us page
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request for the Contact Us page only specifies a HubSpot placeholder, Pune contact info, and an introductory paragraph. A FAQ section was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Image assets referenced from '/assets/generated/' path instead of '/images/'
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly requires all images to be stored in and referenced from the /images folder. Using /assets/generated/ is an unrequested deviation.

hallucinated_features.description: Dark mode CSS variables defined in frontend/index.css (.dark class)
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly prohibits dark mode or alternate color themes.
